With a connected Tell & Go account this works for any of the traveller's own bookings; call list_my_bookings to find their ids. tools.description: Explains how to cancel a Tell & Go booking: the traveller uses the secure cancellation link in their confirmation email, which shows the policy and refund before confirming. This tool does not cancel bookings.

tools.name: save_quote
tools.description: Send a stay the traveller is considering (property, dates, party, the total you showed them) to the Tell & Go team, with the traveller's email (and phone if they want a call or WhatsApp), so a person follows up with them about it. Use it when the traveller is not ready to book now but wants the quot

tools.name: request_callback
tools.description: Ask the Tell & Go team to contact the traveller by email, or by phone/WhatsApp if they give a number, about a trip or a question you could not settle here (a property, dates and notes are optional context). It does not book, reserve or hold anything. ONLY call this after the traveller explicitly agr

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel one of the connected traveller's bookings in two steps. Step 1: call with booking_id only. Nothing changes; you receive consequences (the exact refund and any amount kept) and a consent_token. Show message_for_user and the amounts to the traveller and ask them to confirm. Do this every time;

tools.name: list_my_bookings
tools.description: List the bookings on the connected traveller's account, newest first, with each one's current status. Poll this to learn whether a booking went through or changed: pass updated_since with the polled_at of your last call to see only what moved. Requires the traveller to connect their Tell & Go accoun

tools.name: request_offer
tools.description: Ask for one firm all-in total for a stay from get_quote, for the connected traveller. Pass quote_id and option_token from get_quote, and the condition codes the traveller has agreed to in conditions_accepted. Read the codes and what they require with get_offer_rule_card. Only those inputs are read.

tools.name: get_offer_rule_card
tools.description: Return the public rules for request_offer: the condition codes, what each requires and how it is verified, how a total is set, and the limits. Takes no input and needs no connection.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_booking, get_cancellation_instructions, save_quote, request_callback · Private data: search_stays, save_quote, request_callback · Public sink: get_cancellation_instructions, save_quote, request_callback, request_offer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_booking, get_cancellation_instructions, save_quote, request_callback · Private data: search_stays, save_quote, request_callback · Public sink: get_cancellation_instructions, save_quote, request_callback, request_offer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
